visibleDescriptionAndLegend.text:
Diviner Christiansen feature, 2009–2016
≤8.0
8.25
≥8.5 µm

Diviner measures a thermal-infrared emissivity peak related to silicate composition. This 2021 map corrects viewing geometry and space weathering. Colors span 8.0–8.5 µm; values outside that range share endpoint colors. This is a composition proxy, not mineral abundance; residual topographic effects remain, especially above 50° latitude. Gray grid marks missing observations and latitudes beyond ±70°.
